raw_tokens.value: Bolt Ace Class Feature.Gunslinger Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

A bolt ace can spend 1 grit point when making a crossbow attack as a standard action and ignore the effects of concealment (though not total concealment) and cover (other than total cover) against that shot.
